task: Exploratory retrospective classification of observed Day-60 EPSS >= 0.1. Not exploitation, catalogue membership or a forecast.
predecessor: ET01 remains closed at STOP_NO_TPG. ET02 is a separately requested experiment, not progression through that gate.
record_policy: Use every observed target in each existing training split, positive AND negative. No resampling, no pooling datasets, no official test access. Missing sources are masked, not exclusion criteria.
training: CPU, new initialization, AdamW, equal-CVE unweighted binary cross entropy. Keep earliest strictly best validation average precision checkpoint. Same validation set used for reporting.
reporting: Primary descriptive metrics: AP and recall at top 5% per seed. Secondary: ROC-AUC, precision/recall/F1 at probability 0.5, Brier, log loss, confusion counts, source coverage and base rate. No threshold search, no independent-test or superiority claims.
